# King Coco - AI Agent Guide

Welcome to the King Coco website source code and architecture context.
This document provides AI agents with context about how this website is structured.

## Architecture
- Framework: Astro (Static Site Generation)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Internationalization: Dynamic `[lang]` routing with custom dictionary in `src/i18n/ui.ts`
- Target Languages: `en` (English), `id` (Indonesian), `ar` (Arabic), `zh-cn` (Simplified Chinese).

## Important Links
- [Astro Documentation](https://docs.astro.build/)
- [Tailwind CSS Documentation](https://tailwindcss.com/docs)
- [Home Page](/en/)
- [Products](/en/products)
- [Contact Us](/en/#contact)

## Coding Guidelines
- All images should be optimized in WebP format and responsive.
- Accessibility is a priority (contrast ratios, aria-labels, form labels, video captions).
- SEO is managed via `Layout.astro` and page-level variables.
